welcome_tagline: Your journey into programming starts here
welcome_description: Practice programming with colorful blocks, bite-sized challenges, and instant feedback. Perfect for digital literacy lessons.
login_subtitle: Use your learning code or school account. The demo below works without an account.
login_account_managed_hint: School accounts are created by a teacher or administrator. Ask them if you need access.
login_sso_hint: Use your school email — you'll be redirected to your school's identity provider.

settings_auth_mode_label: Password login when SSO is configured
settings_auth_mode_always: Always show — password and SSO side by side
settings_auth_mode_fallback: Hide by default — SSO primary, password reachable via a link
settings_auth_mode_hint: The password form is never disabled, so admins can still recover if the IdP is down. This only controls whether it is shown by default on the login page.

cms_description: Manage exercises, quizzes, and educational content
settings_description: Find account details, learning links, privacy information, and help for common account questions.
settings_account_description: This hub summarizes what you can review without changing account data from this page.
settings_account_profile_hint: Your profile and role are managed by the school or platform administrator.
settings_account_courses_suffix: to continue assigned courses and review progress.
settings_appearance_description: BlockQuiz currently keeps display choices simple and consistent for learners.
settings_language_hint: Use the language selector in the app navigation to switch between German and English.
settings_theme_hint: Use the theme toggle in the app header to switch between light and dark mode.
settings_data_description: Learning progress is used to show course progress and support teaching workflows.
settings_data_progress_hint: Authenticated progress is linked to your account; demo progress stays on the current device.
settings_support_description: If something looks wrong, ask your teacher or administrator to check your course access and account status.
settings_password_hint: Use the password reset option on the login page, or ask an administrator to reset your password.
settings_support_admin_prefix: Administrators can review user status and password reset options in
settings_admin_description: Configure single sign-on, email transport, and IdP role mapping. Changes take effect immediately. Environment variables, if set, override values stored here.
settings_sso_description: Register the school's OIDC or SAML provider (Entra ID, Google). Users from the configured domain can sign in with SSO; new users are created on first login.
settings_sso_callback_label: Redirect URI to register at the IdP:
settings_sso_callback_hint: Copy this into the OIDC application's redirect URIs.
settings_sso_callback_hint_new: Save the provider to generate a stable callback URL. The provider ID is auto-generated (UUID) and stays constant — paste the resulting URL into the IdP's redirect URI list.
settings_sso_delete_confirm: Delete SSO provider "{id}"? Users in this domain will no longer be able to sign in with SSO.
settings_sso_saml_sp_private_key: SP private key (optional, for signed AuthnRequest)
settings_email_description: Used for password reset links. Pick the file driver for development; SMTP or Microsoft Graph for production.
settings_role_description: Comma-separated lists of IdP group names. Users in any matching group are granted that BlockQuiz role on every login; everyone else falls through to Student.
settings_role_hint: Group changes in the IdP propagate at the next login.
player_replay_hint: Watch your program one step at a time to see exactly what it does.
player_code_readout_hint: Here is what your blocks will do when you run them, in plain language.
